source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

intelligence.enrichment: Lime water turns milky when it reacts with carbon dioxide; exhaled air turns lime water milky and has more carbon dioxide than inhaled air, while exhaled air still contains oxygen because not all inhaled oxygen is used up. body uses some inhaled oxygen and releases carbon dioxide -> exhaled air has higher carbon dioxide and lower oxygen -> lime water turns milky with exhaled air The learner correctly applies this rule: Lime water turns milky when it reacts with carbon dioxide; exhaled air turns lime water milky and has more carbon dioxide than inhaled air, while exhaled air still contains oxygen because not all inhaled oxygen is used up. Exhaled air is only carbon dioxide, with no useful oxygen left in it.
